title: Disable the scheduled triage Routine in the Routines UI — superseded by the direct-session self-timed triage seat
body:
Filed by the Director seat (session `session_01MnijPVVDakqK2J335JoJtq`), 2026-08-27, executing the ruling on #12706 (triage runs as a normal direct session, self-timed at ≤55 minutes; tier-gated duties via transcript-verified fable subagents).

## The manual action awaited

In the claude.ai Routines UI, **disable** the scheduled triage Routine `trig_01XhwLupWiUBp7GUEigK1RFW`. One click; do not delete (its run history stays readable).

## Why

- Superseded: the #12706 ruling moves the triage seat off the scheduled-Routine transport entirely.
- Cost: leaving it enabled double-fires triage rounds alongside the self-timed direct session — the mutex four-readings serialize correctness either way, but every extra fire burns a probe round for nothing.
- Reliability history: the scheduled shape had a measured dead window (2026-08-26 18:05Z → ~12h zero fires) and cannot machine-read its own serving tier.

## Exit

`pm:awaiting-maintainer` per the ledger discipline: closes when the Routine shows disabled — the verifying seat confirms via the Routines listing (or your say-so in chat), removes the label + evidence comment in the same stroke.

Refs: #12706 (the ruling) · the Director seat post carries this item on the 待您 ledger until done.
